titles.title: Four Dark Red Oak Leaves

description: Four burgundy oak leaves intersect at the center of this composition. At the bottom left corner of the image, two smaller oak leaves in shades of bright red and green are visible. These leaves sit against an abstract background in shades of red and brown.
title: Four Dark Red Oak Leaves
